title: SnapshotCase
description: A per-case-version metadata file in the snapshot (`cases/<slug>/<version>.json`): the site-facing slice of a test-case version used to frame a run. Derived from the ingested manifest, with no spec bodies, no mockup HTML, and no host paths.

reviewItems.description: Reviewer checklist items additive to the common ones, surfaced only when this variant is selected. Carry their point weights so the site can score and break down runs.

checks.description: The declared checks, without their action lists (those are a runner concern).

references.description: Reference media exposed as snapshot-relative keys the site resolves to absolute URLs. A common reference carries a null `variant`; a variant-scoped one carries the variant slug.

kind.description: How the reference is produced (a rendered mockup and a static image both display as an image; a video displays with controls).

key.description: Snapshot-relative object key of the reference media.

commonReviewItems.description: Reviewer checklist items shared by every variant, with their point weights so the site can compute run scores.

domains.description: The case's scoring domains. A reviewer rates each independently; the run's overall rating is the worst across them.

weight.description: Points this item is worth toward the run's score: a pass earns this weight, a fail earns none.

domain.description: Optional scoring domain (by id) this item belongs to, or null for a general item.
